clips.prompt: Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, cosy student room with a desk and a laptop. JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie, friendly face. Jonas sits at his desk on a Sunday evening with three coloured sticky notes in front of him. He picks one up, looks at it worried, puts it down, picks up another, then rests his chin on his hand and looks at the camera with a tired comic sigh. Gentle comic timing.

Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, cosy student room. Same JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie. Jonas picks up his phone, holds it to his ear, nods and smiles while talking briefly, then hangs up and peels a yellow sticky note off the desk and drops it in the bin with a satisfied little fist pump.

Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, small cosy kitchen. Same JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie, sits at a kitchen table across from his flatmate ANA: a young woman, black bob haircut, red scarf. Two mugs on the table, an awkward silence, both looking away. A paper note on the fridge behind them reads HEATING BILL. Jonas takes a breath, looks up, and says something gently; Ana's shoulders relax and she gives a small nod.

Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, golden Sunday afternoon light, a path through a park with autumn trees. Two friends: MIRA, a woman in her fifties, grey-streaked bun, blue coat, and TOM, a man in his fifties, flat cap, brown jacket. They walk side by side, then stop, look at each other, and hug warmly. Gentle, emotional, no dialogue.

Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, cosy student room. Same JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie. Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, cosy student room. Same JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie. Pixar-style 3D animation, soft global illumination, warm evening light, cosy student room. Same JONAS: a young man in his early twenties, short messy dark hair, green hoodie.
